30.
(1)    Any  person    who  possess  knowledge  and
experience  of  not  less  than  five  years  in  Homoeopathy
medicine  on the appointed date may, make an application
to  the  Council  for  registration  as  a  Homoeopathic
practitioner in the register.
(2) The Council shall within three months of the date of
receipt of the application verify the details in the application
and hold a written examination to  examine the proficiency
of  such  person  to    practice  Homoeopathy,  and  on  being
satisfied of his knowledge and experience,  cause the name
of such person to be entered  in the register of Homoeopathy.
